goal: Real user pain points about workout / training apps, to inform product decisions for Trening, a single-user workout planner (calendar, plans, exercise library, rest timer / rep counter, workout log, cardio module).

app_types.label: workout planners / training calendars / coach-delivered programs

sources: app stores (Google Play / App Store, incl. review aggregators)

categories.name: UX/Usability
categories.use_for: confusing navigation, too many taps, poor layout, hard to find features

categories.name: Monetization/Paywall
categories.use_for: basic features behind a subscription, price, aggressive upsells, billing problems

categories.name: Bugs/Stability
categories.use_for: crashes, freezes, features broken after updates

categories.name: Sync/Data Loss
categories.use_for: lost workouts or history, sync between devices failing, export/import problems

categories.name: Workout Logging
categories.use_for: logging sets, reps, weights or exercises is slow, limited or awkward

categories.name: Planning/Scheduling
categories.use_for: creating plans or programs, calendar, scheduling, rest days

categories.name: Stats/Progress
categories.use_for: charts, personal records, progress tracking, missing or misleading statistics

categories.name: Integrations
categories.use_for: Apple Health, Google Fit / Health Connect, Garmin, smartwatches, other apps

categories.name: Offline
categories.use_for: app does not work, or works poorly, without internet

categories.name: Privacy
categories.use_for: data collection, sharing, account requirements, tracking

categories.name: Personalization/AI
categories.use_for: poor recommendations, generic plans, AI coach quality, no customization

categories.name: Performance/Battery
categories.use_for: slow app, lag, battery drain, GPS drain

categories.name: Other
categories.use_for: anything that does not fit above

severity.high: data loss, app unusable, or money lost
severity.medium: a core feature is hard to use or missing

rules.duplicates: one row per opinion; drop only exact duplicates
rules.store_review_url: app store or aggregator page when the review has no own link

runs.note: adopted existing CSV: Exa (stores, Trustpilot, forums, blogs) + Reddit API; dropped 8 App Store year-less dates and 7 Reddit mirror rows
